name: Bathymetric Chart
desc: An admiralty depth chart of a shoaling seabed — nested isobaths ring drifting banks and shoals in graded chart-blue, scattered soundings letter the depths across the water, a wreck and anchorage symbols dot the deeps, a great faint compass rose sits over it all, and a survey vessel trails its track as the tide slowly floods and ebbs the shallowest contour.
